meta.title: The work behind the work.
meta.intro: Strategy documents, operating models, scorecards, datasets, and build backlogs. Each file is paired with the decision it supports, so the artifact is useful before it is downloaded.
meta.note: Files are original working artifacts. Product status is stated explicitly: strategy, prototype, template, or test data.

tabs.label: All evidence

tabs.description: Browse every source artifact across collections, mobility, AI-agent product development, and data tooling.

tabs.label: AI Collections
tabs.title: From recovery problem to governed MVP

tabs.label: FASTag

artifacts.title: AI Collections Cloud, Product Strategy & MVP
artifacts.description: An end-to-end product narrative covering the target operating model, customer pain, user roles, North Star metrics, MVP scope, collector worklist prioritization, and promise tracking.
artifacts.proof: Shows the chain from fragmented account truth to a rules-first, explainable recovery workflow.

artifacts.title: Collections Management Vendor Evaluation Scorecard
artifacts.description: A weighted evaluation workbook for comparing collections-management solutions across feature availability, integrations, pricing, implementation, training, and support.
artifacts.proof: Demonstrates formula-backed evaluation, configurable vendor inputs, and a comparison dashboard for an enterprise buying decision.

artifacts.title: FASTag Redesign India, Strategy + PRD
artifacts.description: A problem-first strategy and PRD for a national toll and mobility account spanning toll-readiness diagnostics, transaction explainability, disputes, annual passes, fleet controls, and operator exceptions.
artifacts.proof: Separates the strategy from a shipped app and documents the recommended MVP, non-goals, user stories, risks, and source log.

artifacts.title: FASTag Redesign India, UX Workflow + AI Agent Blueprint
artifacts.description: Experience architecture across citizen, fleet, and operator surfaces, with happy paths, unhappy paths, empty states, and the TollTrust Copilot agent spec.
artifacts.proof: Defines a safe autonomy boundary: AI suggests, drafts, and diagnoses, while penalties, blacklisting, and refund rejection stay human or rule governed.

artifacts.title: FASTag Redesign India, Roadmap, Metrics + Backlog
artifacts.description: A Now / Next / Later roadmap, a North Star with input and guardrail metrics, a RICE-scored backlog, a risk register, and an experiment plan.
artifacts.proof: Connects the strategy to sequenced delivery with measurable targets and explicit kill criteria.

artifacts.title: FASTag Redesign India, Customer Discovery + Experiment Plan
artifacts.description: A research sample, interview guide, and the cheapest tests for each hypothesis, with go rules and a pilot success scorecard.
artifacts.proof: Shows the validation plan before build: what to learn, from whom, and the decision rule for each experiment.

artifacts.title: FASTag Redesign India, Decision Memo + Stakeholder Alignment
artifacts.description: A one-page BLUF recommendation to approve a 90-day pilot, with options considered, a stakeholder map, kill criteria, and a 30/60/90 plan.
artifacts.proof: Turns the strategy into a governed decision a sponsor can approve, including pre-wired objections per stakeholder.

artifacts.title: Universal Data Workbench, Relational Test Dataset
artifacts.description: A relational dataset spanning customers, products, sales, invoices, payments, and inventory for exercising profiling, joins, reconciliation, and dashboard workflows.
artifacts.proof: Provides thousands of linked records so data products can be tested against realistic volume and relationships.
